## Factory review of 18add82: Approve

The fix does what it claims, all checks pass, the 12 added tests fail without the change, and there are no blocking findings.

| Criterion | Result | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Fit | Pass | does what it claims |
| Checks | Pass | ruff format/check, pyright, mypy --strict, pytest tests/client |
| Tests | Pass | all 12 new tests fail on main's src, pass with the change |
| Blocking findings | 0 | |
| Non-blocking findings | 0 | |
| Risk | Low | backwards compatibility: inputs that now raise already failed (422 or opaque error) |
| Review depth | Deep | changes behavior of six public client methods |

<details><summary>Details</summary>

**Intent:** Make `log_span_annotations_dataframe`, `log_trace_annotations_dataframe` and `log_session_annotations_dataframe` (sync and async) pass `annotation_name_required` / `annotator_kind_required` to their validators, as the document methods do. A DataFrame with no name column or no `annotator_kind` column, and no matching argument, then raises a clear ValueError before any request is sent (#17398).
**Fit:** All six call sites now pass the two flags, exactly as `log_document_annotations_dataframe` does. The issue asks only for the span methods. The PR body also claims the trace and session extension, and the diff delivers it. Nothing else changes.
**Verified:** `ruff format --check` and `ruff check` on the 6 changed files pass. In a CI-like env (`uv sync --frozen --no-editable --package arize-phoenix-client --all-extras`), `pyright .` reports 0 errors and `mypy --strict .` reports no issues (107 files). The 12 new tests pass at HEAD. With the three `resources/*/__init__.py` files reverted to main, all 12 fail for the reported reasons ("request must not be sent", and `'Error processing row 0: '` instead of the clear message). `asyncio_mode = "auto"` in packages/phoenix-client/pyproject.toml means the async tests run. `pytest tests/client -n 4`: 742 passed, 12 skipped, 1 xfailed, 1 failed. The failure was `test_xdist_records_runs_via_controller_bootstrap`, caused by nesting it under my own xdist run; it passes when run alone. Area review found that no valid input regresses: the inputs that newly raise previously sent `annotator_kind: null`, which the server rejects (`AnnotationData.annotator_kind` is a required Literal), or already raised a ValueError. The docstrings already state these column requirements.
**Not verified:** Against a running Phoenix server. The Python 3.14 and 3.15 CI matrix entries (only 3.11 was run locally).
**Findings without a diff line:** none. Note for the maintainer: #17461, opened later by the same author, contains the span-only subset of this change for the same issue. Only one should merge, and this PR is the superset.
**Risk:** side effects none, performance none, backwards compatibility low, from the area reviewers

Graded against the [review criteria](https://github.com/Arize-ai/phoenix/blob/main/factory/agents/pr-reviewer.md#verdict).

</details>
